title: Gujarat HC Circular - New Facility of Ld Advocates - Auto Email Notification on Document and Court Fee Submission

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
IT CELL
CIRCULAR
Date: 2nd December, 2021
Subject: New Facility for Ld. Advocates - Auto Email Notification
on submission of Documents and Court Fee in the cases
This is to inform all concerned that, based on the guidance and
directions of Hon'ble the Chief Justice, a new automatic email
notification facility is being implemented whereby the Ld. Advocate who
has filed any document in any case at the Central Filing Centre (CFC) of
the High Court, will be automatically notified through email from the
Registry of the High Court informing the filing of the document and also
the amount of Court Fee submitted therewith, if any.
As further directed by His Lordship, this new email notification
service will be started from today.
REGISTRAR (SCMS & ICT)
